💡 The novelty lies in using electric-field-oriented interfacial solvent engineering with 4-cyano-tetrahydropyran to shield vulnerable ether oxygens from the cathode, enabling high-voltage ether electrolytes. ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This study identifies N4-coordinated Fe–Cu dual-atom sites as optimal for acidic oxygen reduction, revealing that metal-vacant N–C ligands are key to synthesizing them. The Fe–Cu bond enhances durability by suppressing Fe redox, carbon corrosion, and demetalation. This rational design strategy enables precise control over dual-atom coordination environments, advancing stable, low-cost fuel cells.

item.title: Cu 1.81 S/CoS 2 heterostructure confined by MXenes for high capacity sodium-ion battery anodes
item.description:
هتروساختار Cu1.81S/CoS2 محدودشده در MXene با تسریع مهاجرت Na+ و کاهش انبساط حجمی، عملکرد الکتروشیمیایی برجسته‌ای در آند باتری یون سدیم ارائه می‌دهد.
Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 MXene-confined Cu1.81S/CoS2 heterojunctions are novel, combining optimized interface states for fast Na+ migration with structural buffering against volume expansion. This design yields high-capacity, stable sodium-ion battery anodes, offering a significant advance in durable, high-performance energy storage.
🏷 sodium-ion battery · MXene · Cu1.81S/CoS2 heterostructure · anode · Na+ migration

item.title: Waste cigarette butt-derived porous carbon frameworks for high-Si-content Si/C anodes: composition-dependent kinetics and structural evolution
item.description:

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers upcycling waste cigarette butts into porous carbon scaffolds for high-Si-content Si/C anodes. The optimized Si/WCBC 3:1 composite uniquely balances capacity, ion/electron transport, and strain accommodation, revealing composition-dependent kinetics and structural evolution. It offers a sustainable, high-performance anode design, advancing both waste valorization and next-generation lithium-ion battery technology.
🏷 Si/C anode · cigarette butt carbon · porous carbon · lithium-ion battery · structural evolution

item.title: One-pot coupled sulfur doping and glycine intercalation enabling dual-interfacial modulation of layered NH 4 V 4 O 10 for durable aqueous zinc-ion battery cathodes
item.description:
دوپینگ گوگرد و میان‌لایه‌ای گلیسین به‌طور هم‌زمان رابط‌های NH4V4O10 را برای کاتد پایدار باتری یون روی آبی تنظیم می‌کند.
Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces a one-pot hydrothermal method achieving simultaneous sulfur doping and glycine intercalation in NH4V4O10, enabling dual-interfacial modulation. Sulfur tunes the intralattice electronic structure while glycine reinforces the interlayer skeleton, synergistically enhancing structural stability and zinc-ion diffusion kinetics. This dual-regulation strategy offers a simple, scalable route to durable aqueous zinc-ion battery cathodes.
🏷 zinc-ion battery · NH4V4O10 · sulfur doping · glycine intercalation · cathode

item.title: Invoking classical metallurgical phenomenon of ‘precipitation strengthening’ to develop highly stable nanoscaled/hard carbon buffer-free Sn-based anodes for Na-ion batteries
item.description:
با الهام از استحکام‌بخشی رسوبی، آندهای قلعی نانومقیاس بدون بافر برای باتری‌های یون سدیم با پایداری بالا توسعه یافته‌اند.
Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work uniquely applies classical precipitation strengthening to design buffer-free Sn-based anodes, eliminating the need for carbon matrices. By forming stable nanoscale precipitates, it suppresses pulverization and enhances cycling stability. This metallurgical approach offers a novel, scalable strategy for high-volumetric-energy, thermally stable Na-ion battery anodes.

item.title: Fluorinated side chain-induced ordered hydrophilic channels in poly(terphenyl isatin) membranes toward superior ion selectivity for vanadium redox flow batteries
item.description:
افزودن زنجیره‌های جانبی فلوئوردار به غشای poly(terphenyl isatin) کانال‌های آبدوست منظم ایجاد کرده و انتخاب‌پذیری یونی را در باتری جریان ردوکس وانادیوم بهبود می‌دهد.
Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Fluorinated side chains in poly(terphenyl isatin) membranes create ordered hydrophilic channels, decoupling proton conductivity from vanadium permeability. This breakthrough overcomes the longstanding conductivity–selectivity trade-off in vanadium redox flow batteries, enabling superior ion selectivity and improved battery performance.
